description: OpenClaw workspace health auditor (read-only inspection): scans an agent workspace for directory-structure compliance, task/PROGRESS.md health, memory-log gaps, knowledge-base index orphans and junk files; outputs a severity-graded report (red/yellow/green) with fix suggestions via a zero-dependency
